verdict.rationale: Highnote's own Secure Inputs SDK lets cardholders set and update their PIN from the developer's UI via iframes, so the PIN half of the story is self-serve without support tickets. The pack has no evidence of 3DS enrollment or management through the API. missing for 10: 3DS enrollment/management via API, documented PIN reset (forgotten-PIN) flow and server-side API mutations for PIN, regional 3DS handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
